Browser profile configuration persists and reuses browser state across crawl sessions

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"},\"browser_profile\":\"test-profile\"}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.browser_used)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
```
